pages.text: $(italic)Aggressive, hungry, and hits like a falling anvil. Orcs excel in sustained melee at the cost of resource drain.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Ferocity$(/bold) — +12% attack speed. Pairs extremely well with Berserker's Blood Fury.$(br2)$(bold)Knockback Mastery$(/bold) — +30% knockback dealt. Enemies you hit stagger further. Useful for crowd control.$(br2)$(bold)Hunger Drain$(/bold) — +35% food drain rate. The highest penalty in the pack. Always eat before fights.$(br2)$(bold)Brutish$(/bold) — Immunity to Weakness potion effect. Resistance to Slowness is halved in duration.
